author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Testing PlayStation 2 Games on the Steam Deck
summary: Your Player 2 narrows an early Steam Deck review to PCSX2, checking five demanding games and personal favourites while discussing the handheld-specific considerations that appear beyond basic installation.
searchKeywords: Shadow of the Colossus Steam Deck

blocks.text: The thirteen-minute test opens with PCSX2 considerations and then gives separate chapters to Shadow of the Colossus, Silent Hill 2, Killzone, Grand Theft Auto: Vice City and God of War II. Those titles cover heavy effects, streaming, unusual rendering and very different pacing, after which the creator adds less standardized personal favourites. Compared with an input-configuration guide, this video concentrates on the experience of carrying a PS2 library on the original Deck and where individual games challenge that promise.

Recorded in July 2022, the test predates substantial SteamOS, PCSX2 and OLED Deck changes. It does not publish emulator build, power limit, renderer, internal resolution, frame-time graphs or battery measurements, and accessory links are affiliate-funded. A few minutes from each title cannot establish completion or shader correctness. Use the named games as reproducible stress leads, but match software, wattage, cooling and the same save location. Current Deck guidance should come from maintained documentation rather than this early snapshot.
